description: A board two of the eight turns put into the same box. XO.....OX turned a quarter clockwise and a quarter anticlockwise both give ..XO.OX.., and they send the box's squares to different real squares: box square 0 is the real square 6 by the first and 2 by the second. The rule is the first turn in the fixed order, the clockwise quarter, and both languages must keep that order. The box is its own half turn, so 0 and 8, 1 and 7 are one move each, and 0, 1 and 4 hold beads.

cases.name: the first bead is box square 0, the real board's square 6
the second and third beads are box square 1, the real board's square 3
